assessment_details.rationale: O has no matched CPO sparse regularizer or ZeRO-3 owner-only gradient-injection/world-size-scaling mechanism; this is outside O's current software-agent control plane.
O has fail-closed evidence discipline but no matched scaled four-corner NIG e-valid denominator construction or directed numerical certificate.
O has protected/held-out evaluation and repeated-decision guards, but no matched e-process minimax alpha-selector theorem separating target-null decision safety from numerical coverage.
O already distinguishes fresh independent evaluation from reused context, but lacks this exact post-selection fresh-confirm statistical reporting mechanism and matched coverage/cost study.
O preserves durable evidence and contradictions, but no matched memory lifecycle that carries verifier metadata through retrieval, conflict resolution, summarization and archival.
O has connector receipts and source-bound observations, but no attested end-to-end LLM-router plaintext/tool-call integrity boundary comparable to the TEE passthrough mechanism.
O separately protects secrets and effect dispatch, so the architectural split overlaps strongly; it lacks a matched dual-boundary benchmark under compromised planner/runtime.
O has recovery targeting and bounded repair concepts but no matched suspicious-node selective replay evaluation with rescue-versus-disruption accounting.
O has fault handling and tool routing, but no matched deterministic fault-class recovery benchmark that separates repairable timeout/schema faults from authorization/rate-limit reachability failures.
O has fence/CAS/idempotency and recovery evidence, but not this explicit evidence-monotone LOCAL/ENLARGED/WHOLE_REDRAW/BLOCK witness router with deletion-monotonicity checks.
Adaptive semi-Markov duration learning with semantic identity anchors and tracker-specific dormant-memory control is outside O's software-agent mechanism family.
O has durable replay and single-writer recovery, but no matched event-log rollover snapshot/lock-order correctness mechanism for cold bootstrap under concurrent rotation.
O already has transition authority, fence/CAS/idempotency and durable traces; the exact transition_id provenance threading and source-shaped handoff regressions are adjacent but not matched.
O has no Shapley/coalition support-credit estimator and therefore no matched protection for rare positive contributions missed by ordinary sampling.
O has evidence bounds generally, but no matched finite-population per-stratum Shapley confidence construction exposing the validity-versus-usefulness failure.
O has no monotone-order-polytope maximum-closure certifier for exact worst-case Shapley completion under partial coalition observations.
O has held-out evaluation, but no matched unseen-seed confirmation of the monotone max-closure Shapley certifier on a frozen game.

O already privileges mechanically checkable hard constraints over advisory scores in several control paths, but lacks this explicit structure-conditioned completion-bound-before-statistics policy for reusable support credit.

O already uses persistent Candidates, evidence ledgers, reversible status and contradictions; it lacks a matched hypothesis-specific evidence-gated belief mutation protocol and science-process comparison.
O has durable runs, checkpoints, fences and exact continuation, but no matched ScienceFlow archived-node rewind semantics and cross-kill-point controller-state equivalence test.

O has many ingredients—journals, idempotency, fence/CAS, immutable requests—but not a single transaction binding exact restore target, pre-archive, budget/evaluator cursors, phase markers and kill-point equivalence.
